steps.action: Quarantine the changed MCP tool immediately by removing the suspicious tool description from every agent context until the change is investigated.
steps.quote: Retirer le document ou l'outil suspect du contexte de tous les agents.

steps.action: Preserve the modified description from the “tickets” MCP server, along with its fingerprint, so Security can compare it to the approved version.
steps.quote: Conserver une copie du contenu suspect et son empreinte pour l'enquête.

steps.action: Enforce fingerprint pinning for approved MCP tool descriptions and reject this tool description because it changed after approval.
steps.quote: Épingler les descriptions des outils MCP approuvés par leur empreinte et refuser toute description modifiée.

steps.action: Require the MCP server owner to verify the tool description before allowing the “tickets” server tool back into production contexts.
steps.quote: Demander au propriétaire de la source de vérifier le contenu avant toute remise en service.
